subject: general
question: Which among the following is the name of the currency of Poland?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Option 2**__ i.e __**Polish Zloty**__.

 
• **Poland**:

 
 
• It is a country in Europe.
 
• It shares borders with Germany, Russia, Lithuania, Ukraine, Slovakia, the Czech Republic, and Belarus.
 
• Mateusz Morawiecki is the current PM of Poland.
 
• Current President of Poland is Andrzej Duda
 
• **Polish Zloty is the currency of Poland.**
